spec.description: Executive-level dashboard for the Online Boutique platform. Shows business performance (traffic, orders, conversion funnel) and overall system health for leadership review.

spec.title: Storefront Traffic
spec.description: Current request rate to the frontend — a proxy for active shoppers on the platform.

spec.title: P95 Response Time by Service
spec.description: P95 response time per service. Keeps tabs on which services are creating latency bottlenecks for customers.

spec.title: Service Error Rate Overview
spec.description: Error rate per service in the boutique namespace. Green = healthy, yellow = degraded, red = critical. Sorted by highest error rate first.

spec.expr: sort_desc(sum by(service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="boutique", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])) / sum by(service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="boutique", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])) * 100)

spec.title: Running Pods (Boutique)
spec.description: Total running pods in the boutique namespace. Indicates whether all microservices are fully operational.

spec.title: Deployment Availability
spec.description: Percentage of deployment replicas available versus desired. 100% means all services are fully scaled.

spec.title: Container Restarts (Selected Range)
spec.description: Total container restarts across the boutique namespace in the selected time range. Restarts indicate instability.

spec.title: Pod Health Over Time
spec.description: Pod lifecycle status over time for the boutique namespace. Shows running, pending, and failed pod counts.

spec.title: P95 Latency by Service
spec.description: Current P95 response time per service. Red = above 1s threshold.

spec.title: Boutique Error Logs - Cascading Failure Window
spec.description: Error logs from boutique services during cascading failure

spec.title: Orders Per Minute
spec.description: Rate of PlaceOrder calls to CheckoutService — the primary revenue-generating transaction.

spec.title: Platform Error Rate
spec.description: Percentage of failed requests across all boutique services. Lower is better.

spec.title: P95 Response Time (Frontend)
spec.description: 95th percentile response time for the storefront — reflects the experience of your top 5% slowest customers.

spec.title: Shopping Activity (Add to Cart / min)
spec.description: Rate of AddItem calls — a strong proxy for active customer intent and platform engagement.

spec.title: Active Services
spec.description: Number of services in the boutique namespace currently receiving traffic. Full complement is 10.

spec.title: Request Volume by Service
spec.description: Request rate over time broken down by service. Shows which services are handling the most traffic.

spec.title: Business Conversion Funnel
spec.description: Business conversion funnel: shopping activity (add to cart), checkout attempts (PlaceOrder), and completed orders (SendOrderConfirmation). Shows how customer intent converts to revenue.

spec.title: Error Rate by Service
spec.description: Error rate per service as a percentage of total requests. Helps identify which services are experiencing failures.

spec.expr: sum by(service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="boutique", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by(service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="boutique", cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) * 100

spec.title: Online Boutique — Executive Overview
